Percent style encodes special characters in image src URLs

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<img src="/img (1) <draft>.png" alt="alt">', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(url_escape_style: 'Percent'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
